title: Google Analytics
content:
# Google Analytics

Connect a GA4 property and read its reports, realtime data and available dimensions and metrics through the Zernio API.

Connect a Google Analytics 4 property to a profile and read its reports with your Zernio API key. A connected account uses `platform: "googleanalytics"` and represents one GA4 property. It reads data only and never posts.

## Quick reference

| Property | Value |
|----------|-------|
| Platform value | `googleanalytics` |
| What it reads | GA4 reports, realtime reports, and the property's dimensions and metrics |
| Auth | OAuth 2.0 with a Google account |
| Scope | `https://www.googleapis.com/auth/analytics.readonly` |
| Properties per account | One. Connect another property to a different profile |
| Report caching | 10 minutes for reports, 1 hour for metadata, none for realtime |
| Social posting | No |
| List the accounts | `GET /v1/accounts?category=analytics` |

## Before you start

The person connecting needs a Google account with at least Viewer access to a GA4 property. Universal Analytics properties are not supported.

## Connect

Call `GET /v1/connect/googleanalytics` with the profile and send the user to the returned `authUrl`. If their Google account reads several properties, they pick one on a Zernio page. See [Connect](/platforms/google-analytics/connect).

## Common errors

| Error | Cause | Fix |
|-------|-------|-----|
| `googleanalytics_scope_missing` on the redirect | The user unticked the Analytics permission on Google's consent screen | Connect again and keep the permission ticked. |
| `400` on a report | A dimension or metric name is wrong; Google's message names it | List valid names with the metadata endpoint. |
| `429` with `rate_limited` | Google's quota for the property is used up | Wait for the quota to refill. |
